classes.purpose: Static definition of an SRL (item-box/lottery) reward pool. Drives the box-opening roll: weighted random selection of item id/count pairs plus a shuffled fixed-reward block.

methods.purpose: Generic CInfoManager accessor; returns cached singleton (DAT_122dec44) when flag==0.
Returns cached manager when arg==0 else 0.

Validates the box via CSRLItemBoxDescriptionInfo and CSRLItemLotteryInfo (id-indexed by param_2), reads the per-slot weight list (FUN_1180e530), requires the weight sum to equal 8, then rolls each slot with rand() % poolSize picking item id/count pairs (dedup against prior picks) into the output array, and finally Fisher-Yates shuffles an 8-entry fixed reward block.

fields.name: outItemId
fields.note: output record stride 4 dwords: itemId at [-1], count at [0], extra id at [+1]

formulas: weight sum must equal 8 to roll
slot pick: idx = rand() % (poolEntryCount); poolEntryCount = (end-begin)>>3 (8-byte id/count pairs)
fixed block shuffle: 8-element Fisher-Yates over reward set _DAT_11de9b30..
classes.notes: Sibling classes CSRLItemBoxDescriptionInfo, CSRLItemLotteryInfo. Likely related to TlvLotteryBoxItemPool / TlvSearchItemPool wire structs.
